piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Meetings, negotiation and agreements
texto: Contextual reading of the final minutes of a mediation or inter-institutional negotiation session: read the points agreed by two bodies to collaborate on a joint project. Analyse how the parties adjusted their timetables and budgets through mutual concessions until they reached a memorandum of understanding.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การกำหนดกรอบเวลาการดำเนินงานที่ชัดเจนช่วยให้ทุกฝ่ายปฏิบัติตามพันธกรณีได้อย่างราบรื่น» express?

opciones.texto: Setting a clear timetable for implementation lets every party meet its commitments smoothly.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การกำหนดกรอบเวลาการดำเนินงานที่ชัดเจนช่วยให้ทุกฝ่ายปฏิบัติตามพันธกรณีได้อย่างราบรื่น» from the text.

opciones.texto: Flexibility in adapting terms to real circumstances preserves long-term relationships.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Monitoring the agreed compliance regularly strengthens mutual trust between partners.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

frase.texto: ในเบื้องต้น เราเสนอให้ทดลองโครงการสามเดือน

opciones.texto: As a first step, we propose trialling the programme for three months.
opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: If it is possible, we would like to adjust the timetable so that it suits everyone.
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: Both sides reached a compromise and arrived at an agreement.
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.

pregunta.texto: Complete the Thai sentence that expresses «As a first step, we propose trialling the programme for three months.».
